column2: [intro]
I don’t have time for the haters, their insults make me laugh,
I’d rather keep on smiling, and let them wallow in the rough.
Haters may despise, but I don’t care at all,
I’m a magnet for good vibes, it makes me stand tall.
When I wake up in the morning, there’s always sunshine,
Negative comments fade, left behind in my mind.
Life is too short, we’ve got to make it shine,
Let’s embrace positivity, and all feel fine.
In my life, everything’s great, even when it's not right,
I always find the funny side, and it makes things light.
Small problems mean nothing, I give them no weight,
I prefer to laugh it off, that’s my best trait.
On social media, the negatives are high,
But I just ignore them, they don’t make me sigh.
I don’t need their critiques, they slide off like water,
Long live positivity, it’s my joy’s main fodder.
[ solo ]
So let’s all sing together, loud and clear,
Life is beautiful, let’s make it a cheer.
Negative comments, we’ll leave them behind,
Long live positivity, it’s the gift we’ll find.
[outro]
